description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Additional Spells: Jump, Spider Climb, Slow, Polymorph and Animate Objects are always prepared once you have slots of that level (add them from the compendium). Magical Augmentation: when you cast a Transmutation spell with a slot on your turn, the module raises your Speeds by 5 ft x the slot level until the end of the turn.

system.requirements: Level 4+, Spellcasting or Pact Magic Feature

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Magical Augmentation Speed effect added by the module after a slot Transmutation spell.
